text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a thin, angry-looking man.
source_text: You see a thin, angry-looking man.

text: 你看到一个瘦小，满面怒容的男人。
source_text: 你看到一个瘦小，满面怒容的男人。

text: You see Ismarc.
source_text: You see Ismarc.

text: 你看见伊斯马克。
source_text: 你看见伊斯马克。

text: What?
source_text: What?

text: 什么？
source_text: 什么？

text: Yeah, what do you want?
source_text: Yeah, what do you want?

text: 喂，你想干什么？
source_text: 喂，你想干什么？

text: Hey, good singing.
source_text: Hey, good singing.

text: 嗨，唱的不错。
source_text: 嗨，唱的不错。

text: Your singing makes my ears bleed.
source_text: Your singing makes my ears bleed.

text: 你的歌声快要让我的耳朵出血了。
source_text: 你的歌声快要让我的耳朵出血了。

text: Never mind.
source_text: Never mind.

text: 别介意。
source_text: 别介意。

text: Hoo!
source_text: Hoo!

text: 呼！
source_text: 呼！

text: Oh, great. You don't know how gratified that makes me. Go away.
source_text: Oh, great. You don't know how gratified that makes me. Go away.

text: 喔，太棒了。你不知道那多么让我满足，走开。
source_text: 喔，太棒了。你不知道那多么让我满足，走开。

text: Thanks. What can I do for ya?
source_text: Thanks. What can I do for ya?

text: 谢谢。我能为你做些什么？
source_text: 谢谢。我能为你做些什么？

text: Do you do music anywhere else?
source_text: Do you do music anywhere else?

text: 你也在其他什么地方演出吗？
source_text: 你也在其他什么地方演出吗？

text: Just felt like tossing some money in the hat, so to speak.
source_text: Just felt like tossing some money in the hat, so to speak.

text: 可以这么说，那种感觉就像摇动帽子里的钱币。
source_text: 可以这么说，那种感觉就像摇动帽子里的钱币。

text: Where did you learn to sing?
source_text: Where did you learn to sing?

text: 你从哪里学习的演唱技巧？
source_text: 你从哪里学习的演唱技巧？

text: Thanks for your time.
source_text: Thanks for your time.

text: 耽误了你的时间，非常感谢。
source_text: 耽误了你的时间，非常感谢。

text: What?!? I don't have time for this.
source_text: What?!? I don't have time for this.

text: 什么？！？我可没时间干这些。
source_text: 什么？！？我可没时间干这些。

text: Yeah, I sing at the Hub sometimes, and I've visited the Brotherhood of Steel and Adytum with the caravans. Why do you ask?
source_text: Yeah, I sing at the Hub sometimes, and I've visited the Brotherhood of Steel and Adytum with the caravans. Why do you ask?

text: 没错，我有时在哈勃城表演，也跟随商队去过钢铁兄弟会和内城区。你为什么想知道这些？
source_text: 没错，我有时在哈勃城表演，也跟随商队去过钢铁兄弟会和内城区。你为什么想知道这些？

text: Can you tell me how to get to the Hub?
source_text: Can you tell me how to get to the Hub?

text: 你能告诉我怎么去哈勃城吗？
source_text: 你能告诉我怎么去哈勃城吗？

text: I need to know how to get to the Brotherhood.
source_text: I need to know how to get to the Brotherhood.

text: 我需要知道怎么去钢铁兄弟会。
source_text: 我需要知道怎么去钢铁兄弟会。

text: How do I get to Adytum?
source_text: How do I get to Adytum?

text: 我怎么才能找到内城区？
source_text: 我怎么才能找到内城区？

text: Um, never mind, thanks.
source_text: Um, never mind, thanks.

text: 嗯，没关系，谢谢。
source_text: 嗯，没关系，谢谢。

text: The Hub? Oh, it's just a short distance down south of Junktown. What else?
source_text: The Hub? Oh, it's just a short distance down south of Junktown. What else?

text: 你说哈勃城？哦，它在迦克镇南方不远的地方。你还需要知道些什么吗？
source_text: 你说哈勃城？哦，它在迦克镇南方不远的地方。你还需要知道些什么吗？

text: The Brotherhood is a couple days west and a little bit north of here. Don't go there, though. They won't let you in unless you're with a caravan. You need anything else?
source_text: The Brotherhood is a couple days west and a little bit north of here. Don't go there, though. They won't let you in unless you're with a caravan. You need anything else?

text: 钢铁兄弟会在西面偏北的方向距离这里大约数天的路程。但是，别去那里。除非与商队同行，他们是不会允许你进入的。你还需要别的帮助吗？
source_text: 钢铁兄弟会在西面偏北的方向距离这里大约数天的路程。但是，别去那里。除非与商队同行，他们是不会允许你进入的。你还需要别的帮助吗？

text: Hmm. Head southwest of the Hub. Adytum is part of the Boneyard. It's a small, semi-industrial town. I didn't like it much there. What else do you want?
source_text: Hmm. Head southwest of the Hub. Adytum is part of the Boneyard. It's a small, semi-industrial town. I didn't like it much there. What else do you want?

text: 唔。在哈勃城的西南方。内城区是晒骨场的一部分。它是一个工业薄弱的小型城镇。我并不怎么喜欢那里。你还需要些什么？
source_text: 唔。在哈勃城的西南方。内城区是晒骨场的一部分。它是一个工业薄弱的小型城镇。我并不怎么喜欢那里。你还需要些什么？

text: Hey, thanks. It's hard being a starving artist. You got anything you need to know, you just ask.
source_text: Hey, thanks. It's hard being a starving artist. You got anything you need to know, you just ask.

text: 嗨，谢谢。贫困艺术家的生活总是很艰辛。你会得到你想知道的一切答案，随便你问。
source_text: 嗨，谢谢。贫困艺术家的生活总是很艰辛。你会得到你想知道的一切答案，随便你问。

text: I appreciate the thought and all, but you're strapped worse than I am.
source_text: I appreciate the thought and all, but you're strapped worse than I am.

text: 我感激你的这些想法，但你显然比我更加一文不名。
source_text: 我感激你的这些想法，但你显然比我更加一文不名。

text: Ah, I picked it up here and there. Learned a little from an old singer at the Hub, and got some music from the scavs in Adytum, in the Boneyard. You know. Just takes some practice.
source_text: Ah, I picked it up here and there. Learned a little from an old singer at the Hub, and got some music from the scavs in Adytum, in the Boneyard. You know. Just takes some practice.

text: 呵，我到处寻访收集。从哈勃城的老歌手那里学习到一些歌唱技巧，从晒骨场的内城区搜寻到一些乐曲。你知道的。只需要进行一些练习。
source_text: 呵，我到处寻访收集。从哈勃城的老歌手那里学习到一些歌唱技巧，从晒骨场的内城区搜寻到一些乐曲。你知道的。只需要进行一些练习。

text: There is a man singing raucously in the corner.
source_text: There is a man singing raucously in the corner.

text: 角落里一个男人在用沙哑的声音唱歌。
source_text: 角落里一个男人在用沙哑的声音唱歌。

text: Your head is a bowl!
source_text: Your head is a bowl!

text: 你的脑袋像木碗
source_text: 你的脑袋像木碗

text: It's round like a mole!
source_text: It's round like a mole!

text: 和小鼹鼠一样圆
source_text: 和小鼹鼠一样圆

text: I'd rather fry!
source_text: I'd rather fry!

text: 我情愿去下油锅
source_text: 我情愿去下油锅

text: Than pay you the toll!
source_text: Than pay you the toll!

text: 也不给你买路钱
source_text: 也不给你买路钱

text: I know your mind
source_text: I know your mind

text: 我了解你的想法
source_text: 我了解你的想法

text: It's a steel cage
source_text: It's a steel cage

text: 它是个钢铁篱樊
source_text: 它是个钢铁篱樊

text: Raging inside is . . .
source_text: Raging inside is . . .

text: 在里面咆哮的是
source_text: 在里面咆哮的是

text: The DeathClaw
source_text: The DeathClaw

text: 死亡爪
source_text: 死亡爪

source_text: I need you

text: 我需要你
source_text: 我需要你

source_text: Like a bad dose of poison

source_text: 就像中毒已深

text: I need you
source_text: I need you

text: 我需要你
source_text: 我需要你

text: Like a rad scorpion strike
source_text: Like a rad scorpion strike
